descriptions.zh:
火焰长久以来在我们社会中举足轻重，而今我们能以创新方式驾驭其混沌力量。科学家梦寐以求的能源即将展现，其超越维持现有文明，能助我们跃向星际。

§H效果：§!解锁新£entropy_crystals£§Y结晶熵§!资源。
descriptions.en:
Fire has long played a significant role in our society, but now we may be able to harness its chaotic power in novel ways. This could be what scientists have long dreamed of: an energy source that goes beyond fueling our current civilization, and can catapult us across the stars.

§HEffect:§! Unlocks the new £entropy_crystals£ §YCrystallized Entropy§! resource.

script:

descriptions.zh:
熔炉为我们指明了新路。摒弃愚昧，重塑炽热星系，焚尽拒绝者。

§H效果：§!
—解锁§Y星系熔炉§!下一升级。
—§Y导管群§!现可转换敌方恒星。
descriptions.en:
The Crucible has shown us a new path for our species. It would be foolish not to embrace it, and we should suffer no fools. It is time to remake the galaxy in a blazing new image, and burn away anyone who rejects our vision.

§HEffects:§!
- Unlocks the next upgrade of the §YGalactic Crucible§!.
- §YConduits§! can now convert stars in enemy territory.

descriptions.zh: 熔炉具备强大能量产出，但并不稳定。若将其性能永久下调至适中水平，既可确保我方长期繁荣，也能避免对星系及邻邦构成威胁，维护地区稳定与善意关系。
descriptions.en: While the Crucible's power is immense, it is also volatile. If we permanently cripple its capabilities, we will secure a modest source of prosperity for ourselves without endangering the galaxy or losing the goodwill of our neighbors.

descriptions.zh: 要弄清我们是谁，首先要知道我们来自哪里。我们需要挖掘埋在§Y[owner.Capital.GetName]§!地表下的设施。
descriptions.en: If we want to understand who we are, we must first learn where we came from. We'll need to excavate the facilities buried beneath the surface of §Y[owner.Capital.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须闯入设施，武力清除挡路的清醒休眠者。
descriptions.en: We need to gain access to this facility, and the awakened sleepers are in our way. Remove them by force.

descriptions.zh: 若能令设施居民依赖我们，我们就能有筹码要求进入设施。应向他们大量供应实用且关键的物资与资源。
descriptions.en: If we can make the inhabitants of this facility dependent on us, we will have leverage to demand access to the facility. We should flood them with useful, critical goods and resources.

titles.zh: 三角定位亚空间干扰源

descriptions.zh: 用于三角定位干扰源的可行地点。
descriptions.en: Viable location to triangulate the origin of interference.

descriptions.zh: 在全力逆转恒星变化的同时，我们自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
descriptions.en: As we work tirelessly to reverse our star's changes, our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive alongside our star's fiery new future.

descriptions.zh: 辐射增强虽带来长期挑战，但短期内可提升工业与能源产能。
descriptions.en: Increased solar radiation presents serious long term problems, but in the short term, we can harness it to boost our industrial and energy capacity.

descriptions.zh: 这群鲁莽的外星人正利用我们的恒星，必须立即登陆夺取控制权。
descriptions.en: These reckless aliens are exploiting our star. We must board their station immediately and take control.

descriptions.zh: 开采站的居民控制着正在摧毁我们恒星的亚空间虹吸装置。我们必须建立沟通，确保他们配合解决此问题。
descriptions.en: The station's inhabitants control the subspace siphon that is destroying our star. We must establish communications to ensure their cooperation in solving this issue.

descriptions.zh:
我们踏上点燃星系的道路，但自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。

§H完成后：§!
    —添加修正§Y热耐性适应§!
    —§Y火山星球宜居性§!提升§G+50%§!
descriptions.en:
We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future. 

§HOn Completion:§!
    - Adds the modifier §YThermophilic Adaptation§!
    - Increases §YVolcanic World Habitability§! by §G+50%§!
